findings.description: Retrieved the three category pages (faculty=1, adjunct=2, emeritus=12) at 2026-11-25 02:45 UTC, after brief.created_at. Parsed 35 + 6 + 5 = 46 cards; names match the 46 brief people one-to-one. No omissions and no extra people on any list. Profile pages were fetched for the decision-relevant people and the institute page for Kalavakonda; no profile fetch failed.

Brief note correction: Aaron Cramer's card does carry a title ("Department Chair, TVA Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Lewis Honors Faculty"); the brief said there was none. The decision rests on the card and the profile Professor appointment.

owner determination 2026-11-25: "the Warren B. Nelms Institute news page ... quotes him as 'a tenure-track Assistant Professor in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Kentucky'. Download it and cite it; decide regular / ece / current." Decided regular / ece / current with effective_from_json null. The article also says he "begin[s] my new role", which could read as incoming; no start date is stated, and the owner determination sets the state as current. No downloaded page contradicts the determination.

Regular ece, current, with start January 2021 from the official ECE profile ("Associate Professor, ... Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering. January 2021 to present"). Would change to joint_secondary only if an official page designated ECE as secondary; none does. The list title and Biosystems Engineering director role do not establish that his primary department is elsewhere.

joint_secondary, ece, current. The faculty list and profile state an EE joint appointment at Assistant Professor rank ("Assistant Professor in Materials and Electrical Engineering, 2021-present"). Regular versus courtesy is not stated, so joint_secondary. Would change to regular only if a page stated a primary ECE appointment.

joint_secondary, ece, current. The faculty list title and profile header both state "Professor ... Joint Appointment Electrical and Computer Engineering", a professorial ECE joint appointment. The profile gives no ECE start date and no regular-versus-courtesy subtype. Evidence is stronger than the brief implied, and the list title is sufficient alone.

Regular ece, current. The title begins "Associate Dean for Research and Graduate Studies", but the official ECE profile also states "Professor" in Electrical and Computer Engineering, which meets the dean rule.

Regular ece, current. The title begins "Associate Dean for Undergraduate Education and Student Success", but the official ECE profile states "Professor" in Electrical and Computer Engineering, which meets the dean rule.

Excluded emeritus, past. The Emeritus status is stated on both the category page and the profile header. The profile Appointments line "2006-Present Databeam Professor of ECE" conflicts with it; the specific Emeritus status takes precedence. Would change only if an official page stated a current active appointment.
